_note: Copy this file to watchlist.json and edit it. Groups are used by `--list` and `--fetch` (holdings, watchlist, all); peers set each ticker's Comps tab; adr_ratio is ordinary shares per US-listed share where it isn't 1; equity_risk_premium applies to every model, with optional per-ticker rates. default_parts sets what new workbooks include: "all", "statements", or a list from dcf, multiples, comps, revenue_build.

equity_risk_premium.source: Damodaran country risk premium table, January 2026: US total equity risk premium 4.46% (mature market 4.23%)
equity_risk_premium._note: default applies to every model; by_ticker overrides it (Taiwan 5.01%; Netherlands, Luxembourg/Sweden and Canada 4.23%). Update when a new table is published: https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/New_Home_Page/datafile/ctryprem.html

brand_colors._note: Accent colour per ticker (hex) for the workbook's title bars, headings and charts. Starting points from memory: correct any. Tickers without one use navy; set use_brand_colors to false to turn them off.
